overview: A frequency-domain pump–probe platform that measures phase and amplitude across modulation frequency. Frequency sweeps tune thermal penetration depth without a mechanical delay scan and provide complementary sensitivity to TDTR.
overviewZh: 通过扫描泵浦调制频率测量热反射信号的相位和幅值，无需机械延迟扫描即可调节热渗透深度，并与 TDTR 形成互补灵敏度。
principle: A sinusoidally modulated pump heats the transducer while a probe detects reflectance modulation. A lock-in amplifier measures phase and amplitude across modulation frequencies. A multilayer thermal model fits this frequency response; conductivity, heat capacity and interface conductance are distinguishable only when the data provide sufficient sensitivity.
principleZh: 正弦调制泵浦光加热金属传感层，探测光读取反射率调制；锁相放大器测量不同调制频率下的相位与幅值。通过多层热模型拟合频率响应，在数据灵敏度足够时区分热导率、热容与界面热导的贡献。
